text:
sam: Heads up — Customer ZenithHealth disputed INV-2026-55421. They say platform fee should be partially credited for a 30-day Dedicated pilot where 40% of capacity was shifted from Private. Need guidance.
nora: Can you paste the invoice lines?
sam: From invoice extract:
```
INV-2026-55421
Period: 2026-05-01 to 2027-04-30
Private Deployment Platform Fee (annual) - $72,000
Support: Standard (annual) - $7,000
Pilot: 30-day Dedicated pilot 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30 (OPS-7762)
Committed GPU true-up - 250 hrs @ $14/hr = $3,500
```
evan: Contract review: platform fee is annual non-proratable unless amended. sales didn't file amendment.
maria: Ops confirms OPS-7762 shows 40% capacity moved for 30 days. No billing change requested there. Customer claims AE approved a waiver. They attached a sales-thread screenshot, not signed.
nora: Proposed finance action: 1) grant immediate small support proration if applicable; 2) create provisional credit memo for platform pilot request and flag "pending legal/sales approval"; 3) place renewal invoice on hold for 21 days to avoid churn while we investigate.
sam: Customer asked for a good-faith credit note while legal reviews. They want a written timeline by EOD.
billing-bot: automated: provisional credit memo CM-2026-940 created for tentative platform pilot amount $2,368.77 (40% * 72,000 * 30/365). Reference INV-2026-55421. Status: pending approval.
evan: I'll review CM-2026-940. Legal: please review sales screenshot and authorize one-time concession if warranted.
maria: I'll attach OPS-7762 to the invoice and confirm pilot metrics.
nora: Collections: please hold payment action for 21 days as a retention courtesy.
billing-bot: automated: invoice INV-2026-55421 placed on hold until 2026-10-22. Collections notified.
sam: Action items recap: (1) revenue-ops approve CM-2026-940 (@evan), (2) legal+sales confirm concession (@nora + legal), (3) ops attach OPS-7762 (@maria), (4) collections apply 21-day hold (billing-bot). Customer expects timeline by EOD.
nora: I'll draft the customer note: confirm support proration if any, note provisional credit memo and expected legal turnaround within 3 business days.
sam: Thanks team — please ping me when legal responds, customer is fragile on renewal. :pray:
